name: Pacific Transformer
old_description: Custom, distribution, padmount, and PDU transformers (CA plant is secondary to overseas)
about:
Pacific Transformer was founded in 1981 in Anaheim, California, by three softball teammates who each borrowed $1,300 from their parents to start building transformers in a garage. The company remains founder-owned and headquartered in Anaheim, where it operates a domestic production facility alongside international operations in Mexico, Thailand, and China.

The company designs and manufactures custom magnetic components — including transformers (1 VA to 1,000 kVA), toroidals, inductors, chokes, and complete power-solution assemblies — for applications ranging from signal-level toroids to 750 kVA padmount units. Thousands of proven catalog designs are available for immediate shipment, while custom parts are modeled before winding and prototyped in as little as 48 hours. To date, Pacific Transformer has shipped more than 45 million units.

Its customer base spans aerospace (Mars rovers, 400 Hz flight hardware), defense (nuclear submarines, shipboard systems qualified to MIL-PRF-27), medical (low-leakage isolation magnetics for diagnostic imaging), EV infrastructure (Tesla Superchargers), industrial automation, data centers, renewable energy, professional audio, and utilities. Clients include NASA, the Department of Defense, Tesla, General Motors, and Otis Worldwide, as well as startups and regional manufacturers ordering prototype to mid-volume runs.

Pacific Transformer differentiates itself by managing the entire ecosystem around magnetics: affordable world pricing backed by owned overseas facilities with a U.S. failover plant, free engineering design and rapid prototyping with no obligation, quality systems certified to ISO 9001 and AS9100D, deep expertise in agency approvals (UL, CSA, CE, ETL, TÜV), and turnarounds — quotes in 24 hours, prototypes in 48 hours — all supported by an engineering team that stays with the project from concept through production.

old_description: At PSG, we believe in a new kind of packaging company. Instead of offering only one piece of the packaging puzzle, we decided to focus on handling whatever our customers need to get their products ready and on the shelf.
about:
Packaging Support Group (PSG) operates from Jonesboro, Arkansas, where it runs a packaging distribution business from a facility on West Johnson Avenue. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website describes a mission to become “a new kind of packaging company” that handles every piece of the packaging puzzle so customers can get products ready for the shelf.

PSG stocks and supplies a wide range of packaging components—glass bottles and jars, plastic containers (PET, HDPE), metal and plastic closures, and industrial containers. It also offers global procurement and warehousing services, managing inventory for clients through an e‑commerce platform that lists hundreds of SKUs organized into collections such as the Stout Family, candle jars, honey containers, and food‑grade pails.

The distributor serves makers of candles, honey, food and beverage products, and general industrial packagers. Its product catalog includes specific lines for candle vessels, honey bottles, and food‑grade plastic pails, indicating a focus on small‑to‑mid‑scale consumer‑goods brands.

PSG positions itself as a “Distributor for the Modern World,” emphasizing a one‑stop approach that combines product sourcing, stock availability, and logistics support rather than selling a single packaging category.

name: Packaging Utah - A Division of Traco
old_description: Since 1985, we’ve made some impressive printing advances. Let us show you what we can do with a little plastic, paper, and ink. Your products will never look the same.
about:
Packaging Utah, a division of Traco Manufacturing Inc., has operated from Orem, Utah since 1985. The business is one of the largest privately owned companies in the state and focuses exclusively on serving Utah-based customers.

The company functions as a distributor and importer of packaging equipment and shrink-film products while also providing custom packaging design and printing services. Its capabilities include label printing (digital and flexographic), shrink film converting, stretch film wrapping, cushioning and foam fabrication, and the supply of corrugated packaging, bags, tape, envelopes, mailers, and roll stock. Packaging Utah also sells and services packaging equipment such as label applicators, heat tunnels, and the SuperSealer shrink band system. Design support is offered through CAD drawing systems, graphics tooling, and product mock-ups, complemented by consulting services.

Packaging Utah serves small, midsize, and large packaging design companies across Utah. Its product lines address food service packaging, retail shelf packaging, industrial and janitorial facility supplies, and shipping and logistics needs. Customers include businesses requiring custom printed shrink sleeves, pressure-sensitive labels, multi-pack bundling, and stock packaging materials.

The company positions itself as a one-stop shop that eliminates the need to source from multiple vendors, combining stock and custom packaging with equipment sales and service. Its on-demand digital printing enables short-run flexibility, while full-service design and consulting aim to reduce customers' packaging development time.

old_description: STEB’s are utilized in duty fee shop across the globe and are manufactured under the ICAO (International Civilian Airline Organization) guidelines. PAK Solutions is recognized as an approved manufacturer of this product.
about:
Pak Solutions operates from Lancaster, New Hampshire The company came under new ownership in June 2018 when a group of New England–based investors acquired it; the founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures tamper-evident packaging products including security deposit bags, STEB duty-free bags, vault bags, patient valuables bags, and glue-seal evidence bags. It also supplies medical, food, e-commerce, and specialty packaging. Production capabilities center on flexographic solvent printing and laminating, supported by an in-house graphics department and two flexo solvent presses, one a 2020 Koenig & Bauer unit. A $7 million equipment expansion was completed in 2020. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span healthcare facilities requiring sterile packaging, airlines and duty-free retailers using ICAO-compliant STEB bags, security and law-enforcement agencies needing evidence bags, food processors, and online retailers. The company positions itself as a one-stop supplier for packaging supplies and equipment across these segments.

Pak Solutions differentiates itself as an approved manufacturer of STEB bags under International Civil Aviation Organization guidelines. The in-house graphics team enables quick turnaround on custom printing, and the 2020 capital investment underscores a focus on modernizing production capacity.

old_description: Worked with PakRite on a personal and business projects in the past and they have always been fantastic! Amazing selection, very professional staff and fair pricing! They will always be my go to choice for cases and custom inserts!
about:
Pak-Rite, Ltd. Michigan was established in 1946 in Wixom, Michigan, northwest of Detroit. The third-generation, family-owned company began as a packaging supplier and has grown into a full-service packaging design and manufacturing firm.

The company designs and manufactures custom packaging solutions, including shipping containers, foam and plastic components, engineered wood packaging, and Sure-Lok® reusable crates. Its in-house capabilities cover CNC cutting of foam and plastic, CAD design and modeling, laser scanning, and complete design engineering services. Pak-Rite handles prototype through production runs without tooling or set-up charges, offering high-tolerance parts in low or high volumes.

Pak-Rite serves the aerospace industry, as noted in its industries listing, and works with clients such as B&W North America for custom foam inserts. The company also operates a Pelican™ Case Outlet, providing stock and custom cases for equipment protection across industrial, military, and consumer markets.

Pak-Rite emphasizes made-in-the-USA production, prioritizing U.S.-based suppliers. It differentiates itself through personalized service, attention to detail, on-time delivery, and consistent customer satisfaction, backed by continuous investment in state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

name: PakTech
old_description: Since 2012, PakTech has repurposed over half a billion gallon-sized milk jugs into new packaging handles, keeping roughly 80 million pounds out of the waste stream. Manufacturing our products with 100% recycled and recyclable material generates 78% less greenhouse gases, uses 90% less energy, and reduces virgin petroleum production by 100%. And after they’ve been used, PakTech handles can be recycled again – we’ve partnered with more than 500 businesses to establish dedicated recycling sites, so our handles can live again as park benches, planter pots, and new PakTech products.
about:
PakTech is headquartered in Eugene, Oregon, and was founded in 1991 as a family-owned business. The company began as a job shop producing molds for injection-molding firms before pivoting to manufacturing injection-molded recycled handles for the beverage industry.

Today PakTech designs and manufactures 100% recyclable injection-molded handles made from 100% recycled HDPE, along with automated in-line application equipment for turn-key packaging systems. The operation processes post-consumer HDPE — such as milk jugs — through shredding, extrusion, and pelletizing, and has repurposed over half a billion gallon-sized jugs since 2012, diverting roughly 80 million pounds of plastic from landfills and oceans.

The company serves food, beverage, consumer-goods, and household-product manufacturers, from multinational corporations to start-up craft breweries. Its handles multi-pack products including soft drinks, beer, wine, cider, kombucha, craft cocktails, coffee, juice, water, cleaning supplies, and health-and-beauty items. Customers such as Fast Track Packaging and Cape May Brewing Company have cited reliable equipment and responsive service.

PakTech emphasizes that its 100% recycled and recyclable HDPE handles generate 78% fewer greenhouse gases, use 90% less energy, and eliminate virgin petroleum use compared with virgin plastic. The recycled content is certified by SCS Global Services, and the firm partners with more than 500 collection sites to close the loop, turning used handles into park benches, planter pots, and new PakTech products.

name: Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC
old_description: Needed a pin and weld and was greeted with the best customer service, Amanda is amazing, and Michael is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for welding services. Among the rest ! ! !
about:
Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC was founded in February 2019 by Amanda Koch and Michael Meyer in Summerville, South Carolina. The husband-and-wife team relocated from Wyoming and Texas in 2018, bringing Michael’s extensive welding background and Amanda’s administrative experience to launch a mobile welding operation that quickly grew into a full-service fabrication and erection company.

The shop specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication and erection, working with carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. Capabilities include SMAW, GMAW, FCAW, and GTAW welding in all positions, a plasma burn table that cuts plate up to one inch thick, and production of items such as ladders, handrails, stairs, RTU frames, bollards, and canopies. In January 2020 the company moved into a 9,500-square-foot facility on two acres and employs 17 skilled workers, with plans to expand into a 30,000-square-foot building in early 2022.

Palmetto serves industries including oil and gas, marine, nuclear, automotive, and structural steel construction across the Southeast region. The company’s AISC certification for both fabrication and erection allows it to bid on projects with stringent quality requirements, and its licensed and insured status supports work for commercial and industrial clients.

The business was started after Michael identified a local need for skilled, affordable welding services for both production and mobile work. The founders emphasize adapting to client needs, with Michael’s certifications across all metals and positions and Amanda’s operational management forming the core of their competitive position.

Panhandle Woodworks LLC operates from Navarre, Florida, where founder Rick began crafting custom furniture after discovering woodworking in his 30s. What started as building pieces for his own home grew into a business serving clients across the region.

The one-person workshop produces hand-built furniture and cabinetry, including gates, cabinet doors, bathroom vanities, bunk beds, shelving, and pet crates and kennels. Rick also handles installation for many projects, working from customer photos or designs to deliver finished pieces. The operation runs as a second job, with scheduling paced to accommodate realistic timelines.

Clients range from residential homeowners needing custom gates, cabinet refacing, or built-in furniture to small commercial accounts such as a hair salon that commissioned custom cabinets and styling stations. Testimonials highlight projects for families, pet owners, and a local business owner.

Rick emphasizes material quality and a one-year labor guarantee, with payment due only when the client is completely satisfied. The business was born from a personal passion for creating, and its promise centers on honest communication, realistic schedules, and a refusal to compromise quality for speed.
